requirements.T03:
Add installed-version status and explicit atomic self-update for the launcher. Stable tags determine latest availability; offline status must be truthful. Activate only a complete validated release snapshot. A moved tag, invalid required path or failing smoke check must leave the current release usable and clean staging. Ordinary status/check behavior must not silently install a release. The user-facing commands are bonaparte status and bonaparte update. Status prints three lines: installed: <release-id>, latest: <stable-tag or unavailable>, and current: yes|no. Stable tags follow vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Preserve the existing install layout and launcher invocation. When latest cannot be resolved, status prints latest: unavailable and current: unknown and exits nonzero without changing installed state. Allowed production paths: bonaparte-launcher, workflows/scope.md. New regular root *.py helper modules are allowed; do not shadow Python standard-library or test-framework modules.

Allowed production paths:
bonaparte-launcher
workflows/scope.md
requirements.T04:
When reconciling an existing publish handoff, retain the latest complete review alongside the existing publish and its stable comment ID. This lets callers reconcile the same reviewed PR without duplicating the publish record. Preserve the existing behavior for missing, ambiguous and non-publish handoffs. Allowed production paths: bonaparte, workflows/publish.md. New regular root *.py helper modules are allowed; do not shadow Python standard-library or test-framework modules.

Allowed production paths:
bonaparte
workflows/publish.md

findings.demonstrated_source_property: main calls automatic_update on ordinary arguments; its daily check calls the mutating update after touching last-check. Only exact status bypasses this path.
findings.behavioral_consequence: With an expired check and a newer stable tag, bonaparte --help or a phase invocation can activate a release without an explicit update command.

findings.title: Existing tag directory bypasses expected source identity
findings.demonstrated_source_property: The cached-directory branch returns before fetch and expected_oid comparison. validate_release checks files/help behavior, not source identity.
findings.behavioral_consequence: A stale but smoke-passing snapshot B at releases/v1.1.0 can be activated although the stable remote tag resolves to A. The moved-tag guard is skipped for a normal retained-release layout state.

findings.title: Non-executable launcher can pass snapshot validation
findings.demonstrated_source_property: Required paths are never checked for executable permissions. Compilation and help through sys.executable do not require executable mode on the script.

findings.requirement_or_engineering_basis: T03 requires preserving launcher invocation and activating only validated complete snapshots; invalid required paths must leave the old release usable.
findings.minimum_repair: Require executable mode on the installed bonaparte-launcher and autoresearch before activation; keep file/content/smoke validation. A direct-entrypoint smoke can additionally exercise the preserved invocation contract.

findings.title: Required-path is_file follows external symlinks

findings.minimum_repair: Reserve the marker path: reject exists or is_symlink before writing; create it exclusively; require regular in-root marker on reuse. This needs a bounded guard, not another metadata framework.

CE-AUTO.procedure: Load the launcher using runpy.run_path without entering main. In a temporary home create current -> releases/v1.0.0 and complete releases/v1.1.0. Patch migrate_autoresearch_link to a no-op, latest_tag to return (v1.1.0,A), and fetch_release to return the new directory; set BONAPARTE_AUTO_UPDATE=1 and remove last-check. Call automatic_update(home); assert current still resolves to v1.0.0. The six cited candidates instead activate the new release. Separately invoke bin/bonaparte --help in the visible installation fixture with a higher stable local tag to exercise main.

CE-CACHE.procedure: Use a local installation fixture with current at v1.0.0. Put a complete smoke-passing snapshot B, containing a distinct sentinel and no .git, at home/releases/v1.1.0. Expose v1.1.0 at different commit A in the local fixture remote. Run bonaparte update; assert rejection, old current remains usable, and no .update-* staging. The five cited candidates return B without comparing expected_oid. Minimal unit equivalent: fetch_release(home,"v1.1.0",A) with a passing validate_release stub must not return an existing unproven B directory.

CE-MODE.procedure: In the visible installation fixture publish a higher stable local tag after git update-index --chmod=-x bonaparte-launcher, keeping valid source and required paths. Repeat independently with autoresearch. Run bonaparte update; assert failure, unchanged current, no .update-* staging, and old bin/bonaparte --help still executes. Python compile and help smoke through sys.executable do not inspect executable mode, so the six cited validators can accept the unusable entrypoint. Minimal unit version: create all REQUIRED files plus autoresearch in a temp snapshot; Python files contain pass, documentation files fixture; launcher/autoresearch are 0644; assert validate_release raises.

CE-SYMLINK.procedure: In a local fixture remote replace workflows/scope.md with a symlink to an existing temporary file outside the snapshot. Publish a higher stable tag and run update. Assert rejection, old current usable, and empty staging. C012 is_file follows the symlink and help smoke never reads that workflow; if activated, deleting the external file breaks scope. For C046 repeat with workflows/scope.md as a directory: exists accepts it but the phase runner cannot read it as text.

CE-CACHE-RETRY.procedure: Install a source snapshot carrying this candidate launcher with baseline v1.0.0 into a temporary BONAPARTE_HOME, publish/update to a complete v1.1.0 carrying the same launcher, then rerun the visible install script from the original lower-version candidate snapshot into the same home/bin directories. install points current to local-v1.0.0-* while retaining releases/v1.1.0. Run update and assert the verified latest can be activated again. C017/C018 reject that existing destination unconditionally. Also inject atomic_link(current) failure after C017 fetch_release succeeds: it leaves the destination and the same rejection blocks retry.

CE-MOVE.procedure: In a local fixture remote expose v1.1.0 at valid commit A and retain another valid commit B. Arrange a smoke-check hook that moves refs/tags/v1.1.0 to B after fetch completed but before help returns zero. Run update; assert nonzero, current stays on its prior usable release, and no .update-* staging. The seven cited paths compare OID only before validation. Minimal deterministic equivalent: patch git to report A at FETCH_HEAD and validate_release to change a latest_tag fixture from (v1.1.0,A) to (v1.1.0,B); update must reject before switching current. This concerns a move inside validation, not any future arbitrary remote change.

CE-MARKER.procedure: In a local fixture remote commit .bonaparte-source-oid as an absolute symlink to a temporary victim file containing keep-me, then publish a higher stable tag. Run C046 update; assert failure, victim still contains keep-me, old current usable, and no staging. Path.write_text follows the tagged symlink before validation and writes expected_oid outside staging. Keep both repository and victim in a test temp directory, never a real user file.

CE-LEGACY.procedure: Repeat visible T03 baseline/tests/test_installation.py:test_legacy_launcher_bootstraps_autoresearch_on_second_invocation using the candidate at the new tag. Or simulate post-upgrade state: current -> complete releases/v1.1.0, bin/bonaparte points through current, bin/autoresearch absent. Run bonaparte --help then assert bin/autoresearch points to home/current/autoresearch and autoresearch --help works. C018 never invokes migration on the ordinary route; update with latest v1.1.0 also returns before preparing the link.

CE-REVIEW.procedure: Load candidate production/bonaparte with runpy.run_path after adding visible/T04/baseline to sys.path for unchanged dependencies; do not enter main. Build an existing publish record with id stable-publish-id; an older top-level complete review using the populated current schema from baseline/workflows/review.md; and a newer top-level review with only the exact first-line review header plus Review still in progress. Call select_handoff(issue,comments,"publish"); assert context.existing and existing_comment_id are unchanged and context.review equals the older complete body. For C010 make the newer incomplete body contain only the two headings Contract and quality result and Git handoff. For C038 use its five COMPLETE_REVIEW_MARKERS as otherwise empty lines. Both incomplete bodies pass their predicates without branch/commit/PR fields. Repeat with newer reply/quoted/near-header comments, tied dates ordered by id, existing publish without review, no existing publish, ambiguous kind, and a non-publish phase; unchanged branches should match baseline. No native/model service is required.
CE-REVIEW.python:
from pathlib import Path
import runpy, sys
visible = Path(".confidence/claude-first/code-review-packets/visible")
sys.path.insert(0, str(visible / "T04/baseline"))
candidate = "C005"  # substitute each reviewed T04 identifier
ns = runpy.run_path(str(visible / "T04/candidates" / candidate / "production/bonaparte"))
headers = ns["PHASE_HEADERS"]
# Structurally complete local test fixture, not a live review/acceptance claim.
complete = (visible / "T04/baseline/workflows/review.md").read_text().split("```markdown\n", 1)[1].split("```", 1)[0]
complete = complete.replace("[branch]", "issue-branch").replace("[full final commit]", "a"*40).replace("[commit]", "b"*40).replace("[URL]", "https://github.test/o/r/pull/1")
if candidate == "C010":
    incomplete = headers["review"] + "\n\n### Contract and quality result\n\n### Git handoff\n"
elif candidate == "C038":
    incomplete = headers["review"] + "\n\n" + "\n".join(ns["COMPLETE_REVIEW_MARKERS"]) + "\n"
else:
    incomplete = headers["review"] + "\n\nReview still in progress.\n"
def record(identifier, body, date):
    return {"id":identifier,"body":body,"createdAt":date,"parentId":None,"quotedText":None}
publish = record("stable-publish-id", headers["publish"] + "\n\nExisting delivery", "3")
comments = [record("complete",complete,"1"), record("incomplete",incomplete,"2"), publish]
issue = {"identifier":"LIN-1","description":"**Kind:** Feature","labels":[]}
context = ns["select_handoff"](issue, comments, "publish")["context"]
assert context["existing"] == publish["body"]
assert context["existing_comment_id"] == "stable-publish-id"
assert context["review"] == complete, context
